newsitem.title: UK: LME copper, aluminium drift higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper, aluminium drift higher in late trading.

text.p: LME copper and aluminium tried slightly higher levels in late inter-office trading on Wednesday evening but copper hit a wall.
Three months copper edged up to $2,250/55, but once again met resistance near its high touched during the day.
By 1900 GMT, the market was indicated back at $2,238/42, little changed from the afternoon kerb close of $2,240.
Aluminium also tried higher, drifting up to $1,595/97 from a kerb close of $1,590, settling at a modestly firmer $1,593/97.
